criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must hold a current course certificate for each of these courses: AI for Teachers and Educators (WRK-120); Building and Deploying AI in K-12 Schools (EDU-210); Building and Deploying AI in Higher Education and Research Computing (EDU-220); AI for Researchers and Academics (WRK-119). Every course certificate must be current (not revoked or expired) when the program certificate is issued; the program certificate is renewed when every course certificate is current again.

Each course exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a program certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
